components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width gold action button for primary calls: START RUN, PLAY, BUY, UNLOCK.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e0a53e; color: #241a05; font-weight: 900; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 2px; padding: 16px 0; border: none; border-radius: 12px; width: 100%; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b9842a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Surface-background button for secondary actions: DISCARD, CLEAR, BACK, RESTORE.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #221a30; color: #f4ede1; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 1px; padding: 14px 0; border: 1px solid #3a2f4c; border-radius: 12px; width: 100%; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Flat elevated surface for content containers, list items, stat panels. No shadow — tonal layering only.
components.css: .ds-panel-card { background: #221a30; border: 1px solid #3a2f4c; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-panel-title { color: #f4ede1; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; } .ds-panel-value { color: #e0a53e; font-weight: 900; font-size: 34px; }

components.name: Pill / Stat Chip
components.description: Compact stat display with label on top, value below. Used in the game HUD for Plays, Discards, Combo.
components.css: .ds-pill { background: #221a30; border: 1px solid #3a2f4c; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; text-align: center; flex: 1; } .ds-pill-label { display: block; color: #a89bb8; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-pill-value { display: block; color: #f4ede1; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-pill--accent { border-color: #e0a53e; } .ds-pill--accent .ds-pill-value { color: #e0a53e; }

components.name: Nav Button
components.description: Small top-bar navigation button (PROFILE, COLLECTION, SHOP). Absolute-positioned row at screen top.
components.css: .ds-nav-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; } .ds-nav-btn { background: #221a30; border: 1px solid #3a2f4c; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 14px; color: #a89bb8; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; } .ds-nav-btn--shop { border-color: #e0a53e; color: #e0a53e; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Score progress towards round target. Gold fill on surface track, 8px height, rounded.
components.css: .ds-progress-track { height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #221a30; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 4px; background: #e0a53e; transition: width 0.3s ease; }

components.name: Badge (Unlocked)
components.description: Green-tinted badge indicating an unlocked item. Used in Collection and Shop screens.
components.css: .ds-badge-unlocked { background: rgba(127,201,138,0.15); border: 1px solid #7fc98a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; color: #7fc98a; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Badge (Locked)
components.description: Dimmed badge for locked items. Shows hint text or 'Locked'.
components.css: .ds-badge-locked { background: #161120; border: 1px solid #3a2f4c; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; color: #a89bb8; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; max-width: 130px; }

narrative.overview: Combo Forge's visual world is a dark anvil — the place where heat meets craft in charcoal darkness. The UI lives in a deep purple-black void, with forge gold emerging as the single source of warmth and authority. Every interactive surface floats as a raised panel against the near-black background, and the gold accent is reserved exclusively for what matters: the title, the primary action, the score, the active selection. Parchment-toned card faces provide a tactile counterpoint — physical objects held against an intangible dark space. The system is high-contrast by necessity: portrait mobile, one-hand play, small screens where readability is survival.
keyCharacteristics: Deep charcoal-purple void as universal background
Single warm accent (forge gold) for authority and action
Parchment card faces as tactile, physical objects against the dark
Heavy typographic weight with wide letter-spacing for mobile legibility
Tonal layering (no shadows except on cards and floating banners)
Generous border-radii for approachable, touch-friendly surfaces

rules.name: The Gold Rule
rules.body: Forge Gold appears on ≤ 15% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point — it marks authority (titles), action (primary buttons), and value (scores). When everything is gold, nothing is.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Depth is conveyed through three tonal layers only: Void → Surface → Content. No shadows except on cards and floating overlays (banners, modals). The system is flat-by-default.

rules.name: The Heavy-Label Rule
rules.body: Every label, badge, and section header is uppercase with weight ≥ 800 and letter-spacing ≥ 1px. Thin, lowercase labels do not exist in this system.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: All panels, rows, and containers are flat. No shadows, no gradients, no drop shadows on buttons or list items. Shadows exist only on physical-card-like elements (playing cards) and temporary floating overlays (banners, modals).

dos: Do use Forge Gold only for authority (titles), action (primary buttons), and value (scores).
Do use tonal layering (Void → Surface → Content) for all depth.
Do use 800–900 weight for all labels, headers, and interactive text.
Do use gold borders to indicate active/selected/equipped states.
Do keep card faces as parchment cream with ink — the one light-on-dark reversal.
Do use 12–16px padding inside panels and 8–10px gaps between rows.
donts: Don't add shadows to buttons, list items, or flat panels.
Don't use gold for secondary actions, non-interactive borders, or background fills.
Don't introduce thin font weights (400, 500) for body text or labels.
Don't use pure white or pure black anywhere — use warm off-white and deep purple-black.
Don't add gradients, glows, or decorative overlays.
